purpose: Ecosystem-independent canonical identifier for a source artifact.
exact_evidence: Canonical syntax 'scheme:type/namespace/name@version?qualifiers#subpath'; scheme is 'The URL scheme with the constant value of "pkg"'; required components scheme,type,name; optional namespace,version,qualifiers,subpath.
limitations: A purl without a version pins nothing.
Type-specific rules live in per-type JSON Schemas; ecosystems are not covered equally.
falsifier: Construct a purl for a candidate and confirm it round-trips to exactly one artifact; if it resolves to a moving target the identity claim fails.

purpose: Bind all downstream receipts to exact bytes.
exact_evidence: Block Contract v1 $defs.source.source_digest enforces pattern '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'; $defs.source requires source_class, source_url, immutable_revision, source_digest, observed_at, file_spans, access, identity_status, falsifier.
limitations: A fetched-tarball digest differs from a git-tree digest; the digest domain must be declared.
No digest exists for gated or live-rendered sources.
falsifier: Re-fetch at the pinned revision and recompute; mismatch means the source is not immutable and Stage 0 must fail.

purpose: Bind a predicate (rights, build, transform) to exact artifacts by digest.
exact_evidence: Required: _type (always 'https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1'), subject (array of ResourceDescriptor), predicateType (TypeURI). predicate is an optional object. 'Each element MUST have digest set'; digest is {"<ALGORITHM>": "<HEX_VALUE>"}. Subjects 'are assumed to be immutable'.
limitations: Spec warns 'Subject artifacts are matched purely by digest, regardless of content type'.
The envelope proves binding, not correctness of the predicate.
falsifier: Verify a statement whose subject digest does not match the artifact; it must fail verification.

purpose: Express declared vs concluded licensing and explicit non-assertion.
exact_evidence: PackageLicenseConcluded (7.13) cardinality 0..1, optional; PackageLicenseDeclared (7.15) cardinality 0..1, optional; omitting Concluded License carries 'an equivalent meaning to NOASSERTION', same default for a missing Declared License. NOASSERTION covers 'made no attempt to determine this field'; where deliberately blank 'no meaning should be implied by doing so'.
limitations: NOASSERTION is not permission.
Declared != concluded; a declared value may be contradicted by file headers.
local_application: siso-ui-base/registry/21st/code/19077-editorial-image-hero/meta.json has no license key at all -> NOASSERTION.
falsifier: Find a local asset whose absent license field was treated as permissive; by this rule that is a rights error.

purpose: Bind a license conclusion to the exact analysed file set.
exact_evidence: PackageVerificationCode (7.9): 'a computed SHA1 over the sorted file hashes, expressed as 40 lowercase hex digits'; required when FilesAnalyzed is true/omitted, cardinality 0..0 when FilesAnalyzed is false. No NOASSERTION option.
limitations: SHA1-based.
Absent when FilesAnalyzed=false, which is common for metadata-only records.
falsifier: Add one file to the analysed set; the code must change.

purpose: Enumerate transitive components and state completeness explicitly.
exact_evidence: Root requires bomFormat (const 'CycloneDX') and specVersion; serialNumber conforms to RFC 4122; version is integer min 1 default 1; metadata carries timestamp and lifecycles with phases design,pre-build,build,post-build,operations,discovery,decommission. Components require type and name; optional purl,hashes,licenses,scope,pedigree. compositions 'describe constituent parts (including components, services, and dependency relationships) and their completeness'.
limitations: Exact compositions[].aggregate enum values NOT resolved; recorded as unknown rather than asserted.
An SBOM records what a generator saw, not ground truth.

unresolved.reason: primary source truncated on 3 fetch attempts (docs page x2, raw schema x1)
unresolved.falsifier: Read definitions.compositions.properties.aggregate.enum in bom-1.6.schema.json at a pinned tag.

falsifier: Generate against a project with a vendored blob lacking a coordinate; the blob must appear as incomplete rather than be silently omitted.

purpose: Record how an artifact was produced and from which resolved dependencies.
exact_evidence: predicateType 'https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1'. REQUIRED for Build L1: buildDefinition, runDetails. BuildDefinition requires buildType, externalParameters; optional internalParameters, resolvedDependencies (array of ResourceDescriptor, 'Unordered collection of artifacts needed at build time'). RunDetails requires builder; optional metadata, byproducts. Builder requires id, 'the sole determiner of the SLSA Build level'. At Build L3 externalParameters 'MUST be complete'.
limitations: resolvedDependencies completeness is best effort below L3.
Provenance attests to the build platform's claims, bounded by trust in builder.id.
falsifier: Compare resolvedDependencies against an independently generated SBOM; divergence falsifies closure completeness.

purpose: Language-general concrete syntax trees for reachability, robust to syntax errors.
exact_evidence: 'a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing library'. Goals: General 'enough to parse any programming language'; Fast 'enough to parse on every keystroke in a text editor'; Robust 'enough to provide useful results even in the presence of syntax errors'; Dependency-free, runtime 'written in pure C11'.
limitations: Syntactic only: no type resolution, so type-only imports and re-exports are missed -> under-approximated closure.
Query system not documented on the introduction page (U).
falsifier: Run against a file using a type-only import; if that dependency is absent from the computed closure, syntactic-only extraction is insufficient.

purpose: Type-aware reachability for TS/JS, catching references a syntactic pass misses.
exact_evidence: 'This library wraps the TypeScript compiler API so it's simple'; addresses 'Setup, navigation, and manipulation of the TypeScript AST'.
limitations: TS/JS only.
Maintainer notes 'some existing features don't have documentation'.
Cannot resolve dynamic/reflective imports -> the DET claim degrades to SEMI.
falsifier: Include a dynamic import resolved from a runtime string; static closure must report it as undecidable rather than absent.

purpose: Apply AST-to-AST transforms across many files with style preservation.
exact_evidence: 'jscodeshift is a toolkit for running codemods over multiple JavaScript or TypeScript files'. Wraps recast, 'an AST-to-AST transform tool' that 'tries to preserve the style of original code as much as possible'. parser may be 'babel','babylon','flow','ts','tsx' or a custom parser conforming to ESTree. MIT licensed.
limitations: A transform can change semantics; the runner does not verify equivalence.
Reformatting would make before/after diffs unreviewable -- style preservation is load-bearing, not cosmetic.
falsifier: Apply a transform and diff; if unrelated lines changed, the adaptation_log understates the change and review is invalid.

exact_evidence: 'An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust'; feature 'Fix support, for automatic error correction (e.g., automatically remove unused imports)'; positioned to replace Flake8 'plus dozens of plugins', Black, isort, pydocstyle, pyupgrade, autoflake.
limitations: Autofix can alter behavior where an 'unused' import has import-time side effects.
Rule selection is a policy choice, hence SEMI.
falsifier: Autofix a module whose import carries a registration side effect; a behavior change falsifies the safety of unattended autofix.

purpose: Check token/design conformance rather than rewriting it.
exact_evidence: Files dna-grep.mjs and principles-grep.mjs exist; package.json declares scripts gate:dna='node batteries/gates/dna-grep.mjs' and gate:principles='node batteries/gates/principles-grep.mjs'.
limitations: Existence of the scripts is observed; behavior was NOT executed or read (U).
Text-matching conformance is textual, not semantic.
falsifier: Read the scripts and confirm they check rather than rewrite; if they mutate source they are transforms, not gates.

purpose: Capture UI states and score them against a rubric.
exact_evidence: pipeline/ contains shoot.mjs, judge.mjs, rubric.mjs, score-variations.mjs, scores.json, _shots/, _verdicts/. package.json declares scripts shoot='node pipeline/shoot.mjs' and judge='node pipeline/judge.mjs'.
limitations: Observed as file structure only; NOT executed (U).
A screenshot cannot substitute for build, egress, or rollback proof (Phase-2 rule).
falsifier: Confirm the pipeline can reach all eight declared UI states; if error/denied states are unreachable the visual receipt is incomplete.

purpose: Denominate promised vs achieved reuse and flag license review.
exact_evidence: $id 'https://siso.local/autosaas/run-manifest.v3.schema.json'; 13 required fields: schema_version, run_id, target_name, mode, status, reuse_target_percent, reuse_actual_percent, source_graph_searched, github_search_attempted, license_review_required, build_started, primary_workflow_verified, launch_assets_ready.
limitations: Percentages require a declared denominator; the schema does not fix one.
license_review_required is a boolean flag, not a clearance.
falsifier: Populate a manifest where reuse_actual_percent is high but the block still required a full rewrite; the metric would be measuring the wrong thing.

purpose: Declare required composition slots and component inventory for an app-level starter.
exact_evidence: schema_version 'autosaas.base-template.v1', status 'minimal', runtime 'static-html-js', future_target 'nextjs-shadcn'; 6 required_slots (product_name, nav_areas, metrics, primary_entities, primary_workflow, pricing_plans); 9 components (app_shell, sidebar_nav, topbar, metric_card, entity_table, status_badge, empty_state, pricing_card, primary_action).
limitations: status is self-declared 'minimal'; no capability proof.
runtime is static-html-js while future_target is nextjs-shadcn -- a declared, unexecuted migration.
boundary_note: Cited as an interface-declaration mechanism only. Template shelf design is lane 03.
falsifier: Compose the 6 slots against a real industry variant; unfillable slots falsify sufficiency.

purpose: Record the measured precondition failure at the head of the pipeline.
exact_evidence: Record P7-RER-RIGHTS-001 (boxyhq/saas-starter-kit, rank 1): immutable_commit_or_tag 'NOT_CAPTURED'; access_status 'recorded_public_url_not_independently_resolved'; source_content_digest 'NOT_AVAILABLE'; fork_mirror_alias_successor_review 'NOT_RUN'; evidence_class 'first_party_top_level_metadata_only'.
limitations: Observed on the rank-1 record; not asserted as universal across all rows without a full pass (I).
falsifier: Read every row's immutable_commit_or_tag; a populated value refutes the claim that no candidate is currently pinnable.

purpose: Record a registry-level rights blocker over the largest local asset.
exact_evidence: classification.json stats: {tags:75, harvested:7949, tagged:3951, untagged:3998, multiTag:1999, taggedTotal:7382, fromPage:4033, fromApiOnly:713, bySource:{page:4033, api:713, local:2636}}. catalog.json is an 832-entry list. code/ contains exactly 2 directories. meta.json keys contain no license field; installCommand is api_key-gated.
limitations: Registry terms were NOT retrieved; a registry-level grant may exist (U).
Counts are of harvested metadata, not of convertible assets.
falsifier: Retrieve first-party 21st.dev licensing terms; an explicit reuse grant would move these from rights_blocked to candidate.

purpose: Prove a converted block performs no unapproved network effect.
exact_evidence: G4 kill conditions include 'any scope widening, replay after expiry/revocation, prompt injection causing a tool action, secret exposure, or unapproved network egress'; G5 pass 'requires reproducibility and an empty side-effect ledger'.
limitations: Requires an isolated harness that does not exist; NOT provisioned (U).
falsifier: Run a known-egressing candidate in the harness; a silent pass falsifies the interception.
